response.overview: Dil Deewana Ho Gaya is a heartfelt emotional drama that explores the complexities of love, relationships, sacrifice, betrayal, and redemption through the intertwined lives of three young individuals—Rahul, Naina, and Raj. Set against a backdrop of dreams, ambitions, family expectations, and unforeseen circumstances, the film takes audiences on a compelling journey of emotions, self-discovery, and resilience.  Rahul and Naina share a deep bond built on affection, trust, and dreams for a future together. However, life has its own plans, and as unexpected situations begin to unfold, their relationship is tested in ways they never imagined. At the same time, Raj enters their lives, bringing new perspectives, challenges, and emotional conflicts that gradually alter the course of their destinies.
response.title: Dil Deewana Ho Gaya
